'''Beem Dwaller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Dwaller was the [[President/Legends|president]] of the [[Paradise Towers' Residents Social Association]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], some specimen samples belonging to the company [[Culpharm]] went missing and the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who had been hired to find them, spoke to Dwaller during the course of their investigation. Dwaller informed them that, during the time that the samples went missing, the Culpharm security guard [[Caleb Clancy]] was at a picnic.
